title: The Other Famous Pythagorean Triple: 5, 12, 13
description: Beyond 3-4-5, another whole-number right triangle that satisfies a² + b² = c².
narration_lines: You know three, four, five. But there's another whole-number triangle just like it.
This time the sides are five and twelve.
Five squared is twenty five, and twelve squared is one hundred forty four.
Add them together and you get one hundred sixty nine, which is exactly thirteen squared.

params.footnote: there are infinitely many whole-number triples like this
